content.text: Noah Wyle has made his first comments about why Supriya Ganesh is exiting "The Pitt" after playing Dr. Mohan, a fan-favorite, since season one. He's also revealing that these kinds of cast shakeups will likely "happen every season." Tap this photo at the LINK IN BIO for the full explanation.#NoahWyle #SupriyaGanesh #ThePitt Photo: HBO MaxThey botched her character development, cutting scenes and reducing her so badly. The series doesn't have a main character, and we understand there's constant rotation, that's the point.That's a shitty explanation. At least I wouldn't have cut those scenes.People jist have the wrong idea of how a hospital works, I blame Grey's AnatomyYeah bc her leaving not even a few months into her fourth year is ‘realistic’. Do you know how difficult it is to do that in real life? Total bullshitPeople think that being in a hospital is easy and people usually have to agree with their life style, but thats not how it works. Mohan was not ok since s1 and it was already moving to her giving up the ER or choosing another section of the hospital. You guys just need to learn how to let it goY langdon tmb debería salir al igual q los estudiantes q no son trabajadores sino q estudiantes! Acá paso otra cosa q no la dicen! Mohan es la mejor de la sala, con una empatía y compasión q traspaso la pantalla y debería ser el modelo de médico a seguir! Le sacaron escenas, y dejaron de lado! Robby y su frágil ego no aguantaron q otra médica sea mejor aceptada por la audiencia! Estoy seguro q paso algo q no dicen! No pueden sacar al personaje más querido y dejar a los más conflictivos!I hate it but I was not super invested in her character. I kind of saw the writing on the wall when her patient came back the way he did. It’s like it shook her to her core or something. Sad to see her go like all shows we fall in love with the characters we meet and we get invested. We have to remember it’s a show and like they say it must go on.If this was the plan all along why 3 weeks was the creator talking about future of her character??? Make it make sense. Something isn’t adding upI just don’t get it! If it was supposed to happen since the begging,than why don’t give Dr. Mohan the good bye she deserves? They made her poorly and absolutely sad this season,for this? Such a shame,and also such a lame! Dr. Mohan and Supriya deserved better!They shouldn't have to explain themselves to parasocial fans who are acting like a crime has been committed. People who know how hospitals work and how TV shows work are the real ones 😂Nothing against Dr. Mohan, who is great, but of Dr. King gets the axe, I’m gonna riot. 😮Her screen time this season,since the middle of it,is basically none. They are clearly deleting her scenes,and for what? If this was a decision and supposed to happened since the beginning,as everyone is saying,than why the need to delete it?i get that the show is suppose to be a revolving door,but honestly until the middle of season 2 it didn’t sound like Dr. Mohan was leaving,even if her character was talking about it and not to say about Supriya's interviews,always talking about the future and her excitement for season 3. Also if that was always the plan,why not give her character a decent good bye? The last episodes she barely have screen time and her story is stuck,for a Emmy Award Winning Show i expected more!
